acceptedAnswer.text: We use Adobe Premiere Pro for editing, DaVinci Resolve for colour grading, Adobe After Effects for motion graphics, and Adobe Audition for sound design.

faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our video editing and production services.

items.q: What video editing software do you use?
items.a: We use industry-standard professional software including Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing, DaVinci Resolve for colour grading, Adobe After Effects for motion graphics, and Adobe Audition for sound design and mixing.

items.q: How long does it take to edit a video?
items.a: Turnaround depends on the project complexity. A short-form reel (under 60 seconds) is typically delivered within 24–48 hours. A full corporate video or YouTube video (5–10 minutes) takes 3–5 business days. We also offer express delivery for urgent projects.

items.q: What formats will I receive the final video in?
items.a: We deliver the final video in all formats you require — 4K MP4 for YouTube, web-compressed MP4 for websites, vertical 9:16 format for Reels/TikTok, and broadcast-quality ProRes or H.264 for TV and presentations.

items.q: Do you provide voiceover or subtitles with the video?
items.a: Yes! We offer professional voiceover recording in Hindi and English, as well as SRT subtitle files and burned-in captions. We can also add auto-animated subtitles for social media content.
We include up to 3 revision rounds in every project. Our goal is your complete satisfaction, so we refine the edit based on your feedback until the video perfectly matches your brand and vision.

items.q: Can you edit videos for YouTube monetization and SEO?
items.a: Absolutely. We optimize every YouTube video for maximum watch-time — the primary metric for monetization and ranking. We add engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, end screens, chapters, and descriptive on-screen text that boost both retention and discoverability.

items.q: What raw footage formats do you accept?
items.a: We accept virtually all camera formats — MP4, MOV, AVI, MXF, RAW, R3D, BRAW, ProRes, and more. Whether shot on a DSLR, smartphone, Cinema Camera, or GoPro, we can work with your footage.

items.q: Do you also create motion graphics and animations for videos?
items.a: Yes. Our editors are also skilled motion designers. We create lower thirds, kinetic typography, animated logos, infographic animations, and custom transitions — everything to make your video stand above the competition.
